title: Health Checks & Autoscaling
summary: Keep services healthy and right-sized under changing load: liveness, readiness and startup probes done properly, graceful shutdown for zero-downtime deploys of Node apps, the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler with tuned behavior, VPA, cluster autoscaling with Cluster Autoscaler or Karpenter, and event-driven scaling with KEDA.
objectives: Choose the right probe type and endpoint for liveness, readiness and startup, and tune thresholds
Avoid the classic probe mistakes, such as liveness checks that depend on the database
Implement graceful shutdown in Node.js (readiness flip, preStop delay, SIGTERM handling) and prove zero-downtime rollouts
Configure HPA v2 on CPU, memory and custom/external metrics, and tune scaling behavior and stabilization
Explain VPA, Cluster Autoscaler and Karpenter and how they interact with HPA
Scale workers from queue length with KEDA, including scale to zero
Load test with k6 and watch the autoscaler react
